episodes.title: Inside the Children of God Cult - Abuse, Scandal and Dark Secrets Exposed
episodes.description:
The shocking true story of the Children of God cult - discover how David Berg's doomsday movement hid dark secrets of abuse, manipulation, and survival.

Dive deep into the disturbing rise and legacy of the Children of God, a religious cult led by self-proclaimed prophet David Berg. This documentary exposes how a seemingly innocent 1960s "Jesus freak" movement spiraled into a global network infamous for its doomsday prophecies, sexual exploitation, and systematic abuse of children and adults alike. Survivors share firsthand accounts of indoctrination, flirty fishing (religious prostitution), and the devastating impact of Berg's so-called "Law of Love," which was used to justify horrific acts under the guise of faith.

Explore the origins of the cult in California, its global spread, and the tragic stories of those like Ricky Rodriguez and Mary Berg who suffered at the hands of its leaders. Learn how David Berg maintained control through isolation, fear, and manipulative writings, and how the group evolved into The Family International after his death. This video also examines the challenges faced by ex-members as they navigate life outside the cult, seek justice, and reclaim their futures.

If you're searching for the truth about religious cults, child abuse in sects, or the history of the Children of God, this documentary provides an unflinching, compassionate look at one of the most notorious movements of the past century.
